Upon scoring multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon or upon scoring a kill with a different weapon:
Grants Cascade Point Ready for 5 seconds.

Upon readying the weapon while Cascade Point Ready is active:
Grants Cascade Point for 2.5 ↑2.75 seconds.
Cascade Point grants 0.7x Fire Recovery Delay for Machine Guns and Submachine Guns, and 0.6x Fire Recovery Delay for everything else.

Precision Hits work on a Counter System, granting Cascade Point Ready upon reaching 100%.
2 Precision Hits: Bows, Linear Fusion Rifles, Shotguns, and Sniper Rifles.
4 Precision Hits: Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms.
6 Precision Hits: Auto Rifles, Machine Guns, Pulse Rifles, Submachine Guns, and Trace Rifles.

WeaponPerks.Name: Headseeker
WeaponPerks.Description:
Upon dealing direct non-Precision Weapon Damage:
Grants increased Precision Damage and 3?% Increased Auto Aim Cone Size for 0.55 seconds. 
Dealing additional Non-Precision Damage refreshes the buff duration.
The perk actually multiplies the Precision Bonus by 1.2x, but the actual Precision Damage Increase results are easier to explain.

Precision Damage Increase per Intrinsic Frame:
Adaptive Pulse = 7.1% | Aggressive Pulse = 10% | Heavy Burst Pulse = 9.5%
High-Impact Pulse = 8.74% | Lightweight Pulse = 6.3% | Rapid-Fire Pulse = 10.3%
Adaptive Burst Sidearm = 8.46% | Heavy Burst Sidearm = 7.36%
Precision Scout Rifle = 8.66%
Heavy Burst Hand Cannon = 7% increased Weakspot Damage.

↑Passively grants +5 Stability.

What even is a Weakspot? How is it different from a Precision Hit?
Weakspot Hits that do not register as a Precision Hit can still benefit or trigger Weakspot effects, such as Headseeker, or Heavy Burst Hand Cannon's intrinsic 9.5% Weakspot Damage Buff.
Similarly, Precision Hits are not always scored on Weakspots, and may not trigger Weakspot effects.
Currently, the existence of "Weakspot Modifiers" is a bug.

WeaponMods.Name: Synergy
WeaponMods.Description:
Scoring 12 ↑8 [6 ↑4?] Weapon Kills spawns a Weapon Element-Matching Subclass Pickup.
 Kinetic Weapons instead spawn an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Kill counter persists through stow.

Synergy ignores the global cooldown for Pickups, but will trigger the global cooldown upon spawning one.
Synergy has its own cooldown depending on the spawned Pickup:
Ionic Traces = 0 seconds
Firesprites, Void Breaches, and Stasis Shards = 5 seconds.
Tangles = 12 seconds
Can spawn 2 Pickups simultaneously if the 12th kill would also trigger a different Pickup spawner.

Kills during Synergy's cooldown do not contribute to the activation.

IntrinsicTraits.Name: Balanced Heat Weapon
IntrinsicTraits.Description:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. 
Passively dissipates Heat equal to the displayed Cooling Efficiency value each second, even while stowed.
Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and rendering the weapon unusable until its Heat is ≤150.

Upon beginning a Manual Vent while Heat is ≥875:
2x Vent Rate Multiplier.

Primary Ammo Balanced Heat Weapons intrinsically deal 20% Increased Impact Damage to Elites, Mini-bosses, Bosses, and Vehicles.

Additional information regarding Heat Weapons.

IntrinsicTraits.Name: Dynamic Heat Weapon
IntrinsicTraits.Description:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. 
Passively dissipates Heat equal to the displayed Cooling Efficiency value each second, even while stowed.
Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and rendering the weapon unusable until its Heat is ≤150.

Upon cancelling a Manual Vent while Heat is ≤125:
Dynamic Heat Limiter | -50% Heat Generation for 5 seconds or until stowing the weapon.
Triggering Dynamic Heat Limiter through reload or sprint after having dealt damage will freeze the timer until shooting.

Primary Ammo Dynamic Heat Weapons intrinsically deal 15% Increased Impact Damage to Rank-and-File, and 38% Increased Impact Damage to Elites, Mini-bosses, Bosses, and Vehicles.
Additionally, they deal 2.5% increased direct damage to Guardians.

Additional information regarding Heat Weapons.

ArcVerbs.Name: Amplified
ArcVerbs.Description:
Intrinsic Arc Subclass Buff
Obtained by reaching 100% Counter Progress through Arc Kills within 6 seconds of each, or through Aspects.
Rank-And-File = 25% | Elite = 50% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 50%

Amplified:
+50 Mobility, 33% Increased Slide Distance, +40 Handling, and 0.95x Handling Duration Multiplier for 15 seconds. 
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer and grants 15% Damage Resist against Combatants while active.
While Amplified, sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.

Speed Booster:
Maximized Movement Speed, 50% Increased Slide Distance, 25% Increased Jump Height, and 15% Damage Resist against Combatants.
Speed Booster lingers for 2 seconds until no longer sprinting, even after Amplified runs out.

Being Amplified enhances certain Abilities.

ArcVerbs.Name: Bolt Charge
ArcVerbs.Description:
Damage instances scored within 3 seconds of each while Bolt Charge is active increments a Magazine-capacity based counter towards gaining a stack of Bolt Charge.
Grants 2.5% Melee Ability Energy per Bolt Charge stack obtained, up to 25% Melee Ability Energy over the 10 stacks needed to discharge.
Swapping weapons resets the counter. Gaining a stack through damage prevents simultaneous damage instances from incrementing the counter.
Acquiring over x10 stacks through abilities will still grant the corresponding Ability Gains (For example, being at x9 and acquiring x4 will still grant 10% Melee Energy)

Damage instances needed to gain a stack:
(15% of Magazine, rounded down) + 2
Area-Denial GLs: 3 or 4?
Swords: 2
3-Ammo Snipers: 1
Glaive Melee, as well as Damage-over-Time sources all count.

After 0.5 seconds of scoring an Ability Hit or dealing Unpowered Melee Damage while at x10 Bolt Charge stacks:
Discharges an Arc Bolt over the damaged enemy, dealing up to 405 Bolt Splash + 270 Floor Splash = 675 Total [36 Bolt Splash + 30 Floor Splash] Arc Damage over ? meters.
Does not count as Ability Damage.

Triggers Discharge:
Volatile Explosions | Freeze Shatter (Not auto-shatter on Bosses) | Tangle Explosions | Threadlings | Unraveling Threads | Suspend Snap on Bosses | Forerunner's The Rock

Do NOT trigger Discharge:
 Jolt's Chain Lightning | Scorch and Ignitions (from Non-Abilities) | Crystal Shatter (from Non-Abilities) | Gifted Conviction's Explosives

ArcVerbs.Name: Ionic Trace
ArcVerbs.Description:
Arc Elemental Pickup.

Energizing Seekers that home in towards the user at a speed of 6m/s, granting 15% Grenade, Melee, Class Ability Energy on pickup. Allies do not receive Ionic Traces created by the user.

ArcVerbs.Name: Blind
ArcVerbs.Description:
Blinded Combatants are disoriented, rendering them unable to attack or use abilities for 10 seconds.

Blinded Guardians have their HUD removed, screen whitened, and audio distorted for 3 seconds.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon being Blinded.

ArcVerbs.Name: Jolted
ArcVerbs.Description:
Jolted Enemies will release chain lightning for 10 [5] seconds, dealing 119 [51] Arc Damage to all enemies within 12 meters upon taking 115 [45] damage. 
Duration can be refreshed by reinflicting Jolt.
 The damage from the hit that applies Jolt counts towards the damage threshold. Jolt has a 0.8 second cooldown between chain lightning activations.

Guardians that release Chain Lightning do not receive chain damage unless it deals damage to other Guardians.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon receiving Jolt damage.

SolarVerbs.Name:
Solar Effect
Damage Scaling
SolarVerbs.Description:
Solar Effect (Scorch | Ignition) damage can be increased through Perks and Exotics, but the source used for initially scorching will determine what it will be counted as.
 
Applying a Solar Effect with a Weapon, such as with Incandescent or through Exotic Weapons such as Tommy's Matchbook or Conditional Finality, will result in Solar Effects counting as Weapon Damage, benefitting from Weapon Buffs and Activity Modifiers that exclusively benefit Weapons, such as Radiant, Solar Weapon Surges, and Overcharge.

Applying Solar Effects through abilities such as Fusion Grenades and Well of Radiance will result in the Solar Effects counting as Solar Ability Damage, with their damage only being increased by Grenade (Verity's Brow), and Super (Heart of the Flame) Damage Increases respectively. Melee Damage Buffs do not increase Solar Effect Damage.
Effects that increase all Ability Damage will benefit all Solar Effects that are initially applied through Solar Abilities.

Activity Modifiers that increase all Solar Damage, such as Solar Surge, will also apply to Solar Effects, regardless of source.

SolarSubclass.Name: Restoration
SolarSubclass.Description:
Continuously restores health. Effect is uninterruptible and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default. 
x1 = 35 [17.5] HP/s | x2 = 50 [25] HP/s
Healing Effect does not stack with Healing Rift.

Reapplying Restoration will refresh its duration to its longest achieved duration, keeping the highest Restoration stack.
If the new duration is longer than the previous longest, the new duration is used instead.
Eg: If the maximum Restoration duration achieved was 15 seconds, a Phoenix Dive or Healing Grenade will refresh it to 15 seconds.
Using a Phoenix Dive after using a Healing Grenade will refresh its duration to 4+2 seconds.
Empyrean and Mercy are both duration extenders, and do not count as reapplying Restoration. Extending a Solar Effect that is at >15 seconds will set it to 15 seconds.

Ignition damage can be increased through certain damage increases if the initial Scorch source had a damage increase.
Eg: Verity's Brow x5 + Fusion Grenade = 100% Increased Ignition Damage.

2.7 + (0.175 * Scorch Stacks) | Non-Boss Combatants receive 20% increased damage.

Deals 2.5% increased damage after x60 Scorch, indicated by Yellow Damage Numbers.

Scorch Decay:
Scorch lasts for 4.5 seconds, then decreases by x5.67 stacks every 0.56 seconds. (~-10/s)
 Scorch lasts for 2.3 seconds, then decreases by x1 stacks every 0.04 seconds (-25/s)
The 1.4 second delay before damage occurs also counts towards the duration.

SolarSubclass.Name: Solar Effect Damage Scaling
SolarSubclass.Description:
Solar Effect (Scorch | Ignition) damage can be increased through Perks and Exotics, but the source used for initially scorching will determine what it will be counted as.
 
Applying a Solar Effect with a Weapon, such as with Incandescent or through Exotic Weapons such as Tommy's Matchbook or Conditional Finality, will result in Solar Effects counting as Weapon Damage, benefitting from Weapon Buffs and Activity Modifiers that exclusively benefit Weapons, such as Radiant, Solar Weapon Surges, and Overcharge.

Applying Solar Effects through abilities such as Fusion Grenades and Well of Radiance will result in the Solar Effects counting as Solar Ability Damage, with their damage only being increased by Grenade (Verity's Brow), and Super (Heart of the Flame) Damage Increases respectively. Melee Damage Buffs do not increase Solar Effect Damage.
Effects that increase all Ability Damage will benefit all Solar Effects that are initially applied through Solar Abilities.

Activity Modifiers that increase all Solar Damage, such as Solar Surge, will also apply to Solar Effects, regardless of source.

Impacts release 3 shrapnel, dealing up to 429 [?] damage each.

Sol Invictus Sunspot Buff Effects:
Decreases Passive Drain by 40%, increasing duration to 27.5 seconds, or 3.63% Super Drain per second.
Light Attacks drain 5.5% Super Energy and the delay between Hammer Throws is reduced to 1 second.

SolarSubclass.Name: Consecration
SolarSubclass.Description:
While sliding:
[Melee Ability] launches a wave of Solar Energy 20 meters forward, dealing 40 [30] damage and inflicting x40+20 Scorch. 
Only consumes 50% Melee Ability Energy if the slam is not activated. Unable to use during slide if user shoots.

While airborne from the Consecration Melee Ability:
[Melee Ability] slams the ground, creating a second, wider wave that travels 20 meters forward, shatters crystals, and deals 486 [120] damage to Non-Scorched Enemies.
Hits against Scorched Enemies with the second wave deal 472.5 [50] damage and trigger an ignition.

Grants 25% Damage Resist against Non-Melee Damage while in the Melee Animation.

SolarSubclass.Name: Roaring Flames
SolarSubclass.Description:
Solar Ability Kills and Ignition Kills grant a stack of Roaring Flames for 20 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.
Additional Solar Ability and Ignition Kills refresh the buff duration.

Roaring Flames grants increased Solar Ability Damage.
67% | 133% | 200% Increased Melee Damage.
20% [13%] | 44% [28%] | 73% [44%] increased Grenade and Super Ability Damage.

Unpowered Melee Hits while Roaring Flames is active inflict x30+10 Scorch and count as Powered Melee Hits.

SolarSubclass.Name: Shieldburst
SolarSubclass.Description:
Enhanced Barricades can be remotely detonated by reactivating them, triggering an explosion that heavily knocks back and spreading out Solar Waves.
Explosion counts as destroying a Construct for the purpose of certain effects.

On Towering Barricade Placement: 
Initially placing the Barricade causes it to slide forward up to 20 meters away, deaccelerating as it moves.
Barricade Contact Damage is increased to 328 [?] Damage and inflicts x20+10 Scorch. 
Contact Damage can only trigger once every 2 seconds on the same enemy.

While behind a Rally Barricade:
Grants Scorching Rounds to Kinetic and Solar Weapons.
For the sake of vertical screen accessibility, go to Song of Flame's section.

While a Barricade is active:
Class Ability is replaced by Remote Detonator.
Passively grants Barricade-dependent (34% Towering | 10% Rally) Shieldbrust progress.
Dealing damage grants additional progress, at a rate of ~100 damage per 1 second charged.

Shieldburst Detonation:
Explosion deals up to 550 [?] Damage and inflicts x50+25 Scorch over ? meters.
Solar Shrapnel is flung towards enemies within 40? meters, dealing 71 [?] Damage and inflicting x5+5 Scorch.

Shieldburst grants increased explosion damage, up to 50% increased damage once fully charged.
While at 100% Shieldburst Progress | Explosion additionally releases 3 Solar Waves spread out in a cone up to 15 meters away.
Solar Waves deal 141 [?] Solar Damage. 

Aspect's Damage scales with Class Stat above 100, up to 65% [?%] at 200 Stat.

SolarSubclass.Name: Sol Invictus
SolarSubclass.Description:
Solar Ability Kills, Scorched Enemy Kills, and Hammer of Sol Impacts create a Sunspot for ? seconds.
Standing in a Sunspot refreshes its duration, up to a maximum duration of 12 seconds.

Sunspots grant Sol Invictus for 5 seconds and Restoration x1 for 5+2.5 seconds.
Sol Invictus grant 100% Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate, and 40% Decreased Passive Super Drain.
Sunspots deal 60 [22] damage and inflict x5+3 Scorch every 0.167 seconds.

SolarSubclass.Name: Phoenix Dive
SolarSubclass.Description:
Dive that applies Cure x2 to the user and their allies within 9 meters.

While Heat Rises is active:
Applies Restoration x2 for 3+1.5 seconds upon diving.
Deals 100 damage and x40+20 Scorch to enemies within 5 metres upon landing.

SolarSubclass.Name: Phoenix Dive
SolarSubclass.Description:
Dive that applies Cure x2 to the user and their allies within 9 meters.

While Heat Rises is active:
Applies Restoration x2 for 3+1.5 seconds upon diving.
Deals 100 damage and x40+20 Scorch to enemies within 5 metres upon landing.

SolarSubclass.Name: Celestial Fire
SolarSubclass.Description:
Sends out a spiral of 3 homing Solar blasts.

Solar blasts each deal up to 150 [35] damage and inflict x10+5 Scorch in a ? meter radius.
Can deal up to 450 [105] damage and inflict x30+15 Scorch by scoring hits with all 3 Solar blasts.

SolarSubclass.Name: Incinerator Snap
SolarSubclass.Description:
Creates a fan of 5 burning sparks.

Sparks explode after ? meters, each dealing up to 90 [27?] damage and apply x20+10 [x10+5] Scorch over a ? meter radius.
Can deal up to 450 [135?] damage and apply up to x100+50 [x50+25] Scorch by scoring hits with all 5 burning sparks

SolarSubclass.Name: Incinerator Snap
SolarSubclass.Description:
Creates a fan of 5 burning sparks.

Sparks explode after ? meters, each dealing up to 90 [27?] damage and apply x20+10 [x10+5] Scorch over a ? meter radius.
Can deal up to 450 [135?] damage and apply up to x100+50 [x50+25] Scorch by scoring hits with all 5 burning sparks

SolarSubclass.Name: Song of Flame
SolarSubclass.Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [~50?%]
Base Duration: 25 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second.

Song of Flame:
Caster is granted +100 Grenade, +100 Melee, +100 Class, Radiant and Scorching Rounds. 
Weapon Kills by the Caster count as Super Kills. Weapon damage does not count as Ability damage.
Allies within 15 metres are granted 30% [?%] Damage Resist, Scorching Rounds, and 15% Fixed Bonus Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy per second.
Grants full Grenade and Melee Ability Charges on Super End.

Scorching Rounds:
Dealing Direct Kinetic or Solar Weapon Damage inflicts Scorch, with the stack amount and cooldown between Scorch applications varying per Weapon Type.
x3+2 Scorch every 0.2 seconds = Auto Rifles | Submachine Guns
x5+5 Scorch every 0.2? seconds = Machine Guns | Trace Rifles
x10+5 Scorch every 0.6 seconds = Hand Cannon | Pulse Rifle | Scout Rifles | Sidearms
x15+5 Scorch every 0.4 seconds = Fusion Rifles | Glaive (Melee/Projectile) | Shotgun | Sniper Rifle | Swords (+Solar Ergo Sum)
x20+10 Scorch every 0.6? seconds = Bows | Heavy Grenade Launchers | Special Grenade Launchers | Linear Fusion Rifles (+Arbalest) | Rocket Launchers
Double Fire Grenade Launchers can inflict x40+x20 Scorch in a single shot.

Grenade Ability: Drains 4.8% Super Energy, and has a 2 second cooldown between usages.
Sends forth a homing Solar Wisp that detonates on impact, dealing up to 685 [?] damage and inflicting x40+20 Scorch. Wisps have ? HP.
Another Wisp is spawned on the impact location if an enemy is within 15? meters, chasing towards the closest enemy it hasn't already damaged.
Can spawn up to 3 additional Wisps per ability usage.
Consuming a Solar Wisp while Heat Rises is equipped grants Cure x3 and Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds to the user and their allies within 9 meters.

Melee Ability: Drains 2.4% Super Energy, and has a 1.75 second cooldown between usages.
Celestial Fire sends out 5 Solar blasts, each dealing up to 200 [87] damage and inflicting x10+5 Scorch.
Incinerator Snap releases a barrage of 7 Solar Sparks, each dealing up to 155 [41] damage and inflicting x20+10 [x10+5] Scorch.
[Auto Melee] against an enemy within Melee Lunge Distance while Incinerator Snap is equipped performs an Enhanced Basic Melee that deals 1000 [456] Solar Damage and inflicts x60+30 Scorch over a tiny radius, consuming Super Energy and a Melee Ability Charge.

Class Ability: Drains 6% Super Energy, and has a 2.85 second cooldown between usages.
Functions as the selected Class Ability, recharging quickly at the cost of Super Energy.

SolarSubclass.Name: Daybreak
SolarSubclass.Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [51%]
Base Duration: 24 seconds, or 4.167% Super Drain per Second.

Light Attack:
Drains 6.5% Super Energy to launch a Daybreak Projectile.
Daybreak Projectile deal 426 [?] Impact Damage, exploding on impact, dealing up to 598 [?] Splash Damage, down to 0% damage, inflicting x50+0 Scorch over 5 meters, and launching a streak of flames behind them.
Flame streak travel ahead, scaling from ~4m to 9m if the Daybreak Projectile traveled at least 12 meters, dealing up to 292 [?] Damage on hit.

Allows the usage of an enhanced Icarus Dash without cooldown that drains 4.2% Super Energy per usage.

Phoenix Dive is enhanced, dealing up to 642 [220?] Damage, down to a minimum of 292 [?] Damage, and inflicting x60+30 Scorch over a 6 meter radius. Deals 45% damage at max falloff.
Phoenix Dive damage is enhanced by Super Damage Increases.

SolarSubclass.Name: Well of Radiance
SolarSubclass.Description:
Places down a Well of Radiance for 30 seconds, restoring 300HP to the caster, dealing up to 150 damage, and inflicting 40+20 Scorch to enemies within 8.5 metres.
Creates 3 Orbs of Power, each granting 3.6% Super Energy.
Super Duration scales with Super Stat, up to 40 seconds at 200 Super.

Well of Radiance:
Construct with 800 HP. Can be frozen and damaged by Stasis Shatter
Projects an aura that buffs the caster and allies within 6 metres. Leaving the aura grants Radiant for 8+4 seconds.
Combatants deal 0.25x Damage against the Well of Radiance.

For Guardians inside the Well of Radiance:
25% Increased Damage, 20% Damage Resist against Combatants (10% vs Boss Combatants), immunity to Stasis Effects, restores 50HP/s, and Radiant's Shield-Piercing effects.
Guardians receive 50% Damage Resist against Special and Heavy Weapons, as well as Abilities. Primary Weapons remain at 40% Damage Resist.
Removes any active Restoration effect. 
Weapon Damage dealt by the Caster is counted as Super Ability Damage. Caster can spawn up to 5 Orbs from scoring kills within the Well.

SolarSubclass.Name: Heat Rises
SolarSubclass.Description:
Passively grants +20 Airborne Effectiveness, and allows Weapon and Ability Usage while gliding. 

Kills while Airborne grant Melee Energy.
Tier 1 Combatant = 20% | T2 = 25% | T3 = 35% | T4 = 50% | Guardians = 50%

Hold [Grenade] to consume a Grenade Ability Charge, granting Heat Rises and releasing a burst of Cure x2 that affects the user and their allies within 9 meters.
Consuming a Healing Grenade increases Cure to x3. Consuming a Touch of Flame Healing Grenade additionally grants Restoration x1 for 4+2 seconds.
Consuming a Song of Flame' Wisp releases a burst of Cure x3 and grants Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds to the user and their allies within 9 meters.

Heat Rises
Grants +50 Airborne Effectiveness, and a modified Glide that changes depending on the selected Movement Ability for 15 seconds.
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer while active.
Modified Glide has -99% Glide Upkeep and Activation cost, extending maximum glide duration by 100 times, and marks the user's location on radar to Guardians within 25 meters.
Balanced Glide: Strong Directional and Initial Burst | Burst Glide: Strong Directional Control | Strafe Glide: Strong Initial Burst.

Scoring additional Airborne Kills while Heat Rises is active extends the buff duration, up to 30 seconds.
Tier 1 Combatant = +5 seconds | T2 & T3 = +10 seconds | T4 = +15 seconds | Guardians = +5 seconds
Consuming a Grenade always overwrites the duration to 15 seconds, even if it was previously higher.

SolarSubclass.Name: Hellion
SolarSubclass.Description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Grants Hellion for 20 seconds.

Hellion:
Lobs scorching Solar projectiles every 1.35 seconds towards enemies up to 32 meters away.
Solar projectiles deal up to 217 [38] Solar Grenade Ability Damage and inflict x30+10 Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius.
Can trigger Grenade Ability interactions. Hellion-inflicted Solar Effects are not scaled by Grenade Damage.

SolarSubclass.Name: Hellion
SolarSubclass.Description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Grants Hellion for 20 seconds.

Hellion:
Lobs scorching Solar projectiles every 1.35 seconds towards enemies up to 32 meters away.
Solar projectiles deal up to 217 [38] Solar Grenade Ability Damage and inflict x30+10 Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius.
Can trigger Grenade Ability interactions. Hellion-inflicted Solar Effects are not scaled by Grenade Damage.

SolarSubclass.Name: Icarus Dash
SolarSubclass.Description:
Horizontal dash that travels 8 meters. Distance is increased by 25% while in Daybreak.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown after usage.

While Heat Rises is active, or during the Song of Flame Super Ability while the Incinerator Snap Melee Ability is equipped:
 Gains an additional charge, and recharges both charges simultaneously, but increases cooldown to 5 seconds.
Does not grant 2 charges while in Song of Flame if the Celestial Fire Melee Ability is equipped.  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress through Weapon or Super Kills while Airborne within 5 seconds of each:
Grants Cure x1.
 Rank-And-File = 34% | Elites = 67% | Bosses = 100% | Guardians = 67%.

SolarSubclass.Name: Touch of Flame
SolarSubclass.Description:
Enhances certain Grenade types:

Healing Grenades grant Cure x2 and Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds.
Firebolt Grenades seek radius is increased by 50% to 12 meters and target up to 5 enemies.
Solar Grenades linger for 2 seconds longer and release Magma Orbs that deal 125 [50] damage each. Magma Orbs do not have damage falloff.
Fusion Grenades explode again after 0.5 seconds, dealing up to 851 [50] damage in a 8 metre radius.

VoidVerbs.Name: Devour
VoidVerbs.Description:
Restores 70 HP on activation and grants Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Devour restores 70 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Devour is active restores 70 HP, grants Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 7.5% | T2 = 11.6% | T3 = 13.75% | T4 = 20% | Guardians = 20%

VoidVerbs.Name: Invisibility
VoidVerbs.Description:
Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.
 Radar Booster Weapon Mod removes the Radar Reduction. Reapplying Invisibility without it breaking refreshes the duration of the longest lasting invisibility.

Combatants are unable to directly target the user, preferring to either shoot at the user's last visible location, or not firing. Combatants will track through Loud Actions, but not fire.

Guardians are unable to see the user's health bar, and the user's radar will only ping every 5 seconds for 0.6 seconds, or upon performing Loud Actions.

Weapons and Abilities that are able to home in (Tracking Projectiles) or scan (Firebolt Grenades) for enemies will not target the user, and will stop tracking if they already were. 

Offensive Actions: Instantly ends Invisibility
Shooting | Grenade, Melee, Super, or Blink Ability Usage | Barricade or Rift Placement | Vehicle Summon

Loud Actions: Pings Radar | Combatants Track
Beginning Sprint | Non-Blink Movement Ability Usage | Hunter Class Ability Usage

VoidVerbs.Name: Overshield
VoidVerbs.Description:
Void Overshield with up to 45 HP for 10+5 seconds. Overshield has 70% Damage Resist against Combatants.

Damage dealt to Void Overshields does not stop Health Regeneration.
This applies to any Overshield.

Cannot gain Overshield while in a Healing Rift.

VoidVerbs.Name: Void Breach
VoidVerbs.Description:
Void Elemental Pickup.

Grants 12.5% Class Ability Energy on Pickup. Allies do not receive Void Breaches created by the user.
Lasts 25 seconds before disappearing. Incurs a 5 second cooldown between Void Breach spawns.

VoidVerbs.Name: Suppression
VoidVerbs.Description:
Suppressed Enemies are removed from active abilities and are unable to use abilities for 10 [5] seconds.

Suppressed Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants also become disoriented and will be unable to shoot.

Suppressed Guardians are removed from their active Super Ability and Transcendence, and cannot use Grenade, Melee, Class, Super, Movement Abilities, and Transcendence.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon being Suppressed.

VoidVerbs.Name: Volatile
VoidVerbs.Description:
Volatile Enemies trigger an explosion after being dealt 190 [200] damage or upon dying, dealing up to 145 [80] Void Ability Damage in a 5 meter radius.
Volatile lasts for 10 [6] seconds, harmlessly expiring afterwards. Debuff is removed after triggering the explosion.
The damage from the hit that applies Volatile doesn't count towards the detonation threshold. 

Incurs a 1 second cooldown before Volatile can be reapplied to an enemy after the explosion is triggered.

VoidVerbs.Name: Volatile Rounds
VoidVerbs.Description: Void Weapons inflict Volatile upon dealing damage and deal 10% increased Weapon Damage against Champions while Volatile Rounds are active.

VoidVerbs.Name: Weaken
VoidVerbs.Description:
Weakened Enemies receive 15% [7.5%] increased damage and 20% Decreased Movement Speed for 6 [2.5] seconds.

Weakened Combatants become less accurate and slower.

Unique Weaken Effects:
Certain sources of Weaken inflict a dramatically stronger weaken that grants 30% [generally 50%] increased damage.

Shadowshot: Moebius grants 30% [50%] increased damage against tethered enemies.

Felwinter's Helm's Warlord's End grants 30% [30%] increased damage against enemies affected by its weakening burst.
Tractor Cannon's Repulsor Force and Fafnir (Quantum Nova Active) grants 30% [50%] increased damage against enemies it damages.
Fafnir's, Felwinter's, Tractor's weaken duration can be extended by any other Weaken effect.

Shadowshot: Deadfall uniquely grants 35% [50%?] increased damage against tethered enemies.

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Cessation
VoidSubclass.Description:
Finishers apply Volatile to enemies within ? metres.
Killing Volatile Enemies spawns a Void Breach.

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Dilation
VoidSubclass.Description:
Crouch Speed is set to 4 meters per second and grants doubled radar resolution while crouched.
Crouch Speed cannot be decreased below 4m/s, identically to Transversives Steps.

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Domineering
VoidSubclass.Description:
Suppressing an enemy grants +30 Weapons and 4% Forward Movement Speed Bonus for 10 seconds and refills the readied weapon.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown before it can be reactivated.

Killing Suppressed Enemies spawns a Void Breach.

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Exchange
VoidSubclass.Description:
Melee Kills grant Grenade Energy based on Enemy Rank.
 Tier 1 Combatants = 7.5%
Tier 2 Combatants = 11%
Tier 3 Combatants | Guardians = 16.25%
 Tier 4 Combatant | Minibosses | Bosses = 25%

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Expulsion
VoidSubclass.Description: Void Ability Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 160 [130] damage in a 7 metre radius.

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Harvest
VoidSubclass.Description:
Killing Weakened Enemies creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy and a Void Breach.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon creating an Orb of Power.

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Instability
VoidSubclass.Description:
Grenade Kills grant Volatile Rounds to Void Weapons for 11.25 [7.5] seconds.
Does not require Void Grenade Kills.

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Leeching
VoidSubclass.Description: Melee Kills begin health regeneration for the user and allies within ? metres.

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Obscurity
VoidSubclass.Description: Finishers grant Invisibility for 5+2 seconds.

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Persistence
VoidSubclass.Description:
Void Buffs applied to the user last longer.
Devour: 50% Increased duration.
Invisibility: 40% increased duration.
Void Overshield: 50% increased duration.

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Provision
VoidSubclass.Description:
Grenade Ability Damage grants Melee Energy.
Can only activate once per damage instance. Hitting multiple enemies counts as 1 instance. Does not work with Unbreakable.

3% Melee Energy: Scatter, Spike, Voidwall, Vortex
8% Melee Energy: Axion, Handheld Supernova, Magnetic, Suppressor

VoidSubclass.Name: Echo of Remnants
VoidSubclass.Description:
Axion Bolts last ?% longer.

Nova Bomb and its Seekers can be detonated mid-air by dealing damage towards it. Caster deals significantly more damage against it.

VoidSubclass.Name: Nova Bomb: Vortex
VoidSubclass.Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [49%]

Releases a fast moving, arcing Nova Bomb that detonates on impact, dealing up to 3021 [?] damage in a ? meter radius.
Creates a singularity after 0.43 seconds of detonating, instantly pulling enemies inwards.

Singularity deals 52 [?] damage every 0.13 seconds for 10 seconds to enemies within ? metres, and repeatedly pulls enemies within ? meters every ? seconds towards it.

VoidSubclass.Name: Nova Warp
VoidSubclass.Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [58%]
Base Duration: 24.5 seconds, or 4.1% Super Drain per second.

Light Attack
Drains 5% Super Energy.
Deals up to 964 [200] damage, and inflicting Volatile in a 6 metre radius. Maximum Damage Falloff reduces damage by up to 50%.
Can be charged by holding [Fire] for 0.6 seconds, pulling enemies within ~14 meters towards the user and linearly increasing its damage and radius by 120%.
Decreases Movement Speed by ?% while charging.

Heavy Attack / Sprint
Performs a Dark Blink, draining 3.5% Super Energy to rapidly accelerate towards the currently input direction and release 4 Weakening Seekers, one in each cardinal direction.
Weakening Seekers target enemies within 8 meters, dealing 193 [?] Damage and inflicting Weaken on impact.

VoidSubclass.Name: Chaos Accelerant
VoidSubclass.Description:
[Grenade Ability] to overcharge a Grenade, enhancing it.

Grants an extra Grenade Ability Charge.

Overcharged Grenade Effects:

Axion Bolt: Adds 2 additional seekers [2 -> 4], seekers travel faster, deal 25% increased damage, and retriggers after a second of landing.

Scatter: Adds 4 additional submunitions, totalling 12. Submunitions now strongly track enemies within 5 meters, and deal 25% increased damage towards Combatants.

Vortex: 7.5% Increased Duration, 70% Increased Radius, begins dealing damage 0.275s sooner, and pulls enemies 0.2s earlier.

Magnetic, Spike, Suppressor, and Voidwall: Releases a short-range Void Blast that inflicts Volatile. Passively grants 1.15x Grenade Regeneration Speed.

VoidSubclass.Name: Child of the Old Gods
VoidSubclass.Description:
On Rift Cast:
Grants Void Soul Ready for 25 seconds. Can stack up to 2 Void Souls.

Scoring a Weapon Hit on an enemy launches the Void Buddy to fly towards them, projecting a Draining Field upon arriving.
The Draining Field deals 41 [10] Void Grenade Ability Damage and inflicts weaken for 4 [2.5] seconds every 0.7 seconds for up to 9.25 seconds to enemies within 10 meters. 
Combatants within the Draining Field are additionally suppressed.

The Void Friend has 150 HP and can be, unfortunately, destroyed. Has ?% Damage Resist until it is actively draining.

Grants different bonuses while the Void Soul is dealing damage, depending on the selected Class Ability:
Healing Rift: Grants 4% Grenade and Melee Energy every 1.4 seconds.
Empowering Rift: Restores 25 HP every 1.4 seconds.

Enemies killed within its Draining Field grant Class Ability Energy based on their Enemy Rank:
Tier 1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 15% | T3 = 20% | T4+ = 50% | Guardian = 33.4%

VoidSubclass.Name: Feed the Void
VoidSubclass.Description:
Void Ability Kills grant Devour. 
Devour becomes Enhanced Devour.

Enhanced Devour:
Restores 140 HP on activation and grants Enhanced Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Enhanced Devour restores 140 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Enhanced Devour is active restores 140 HP, grants doubled Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 15% | T2 = 23.2% | T3 = 27.5% | T4 = 40% | Guardians = 40%

VoidSubclass.Name: Feed the Void
VoidSubclass.Description:
Void Ability Kills grant Devour. 
Devour becomes Enhanced Devour.

Enhanced Devour:
Restores 140 HP on activation and grants Enhanced Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Enhanced Devour restores 140 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Enhanced Devour is active restores 140 HP, grants doubled Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 15% | T2 = 23.2% | T3 = 27.5% | T4 = 40% | Guardians = 40%

VoidSubclass.Name: Soul Siphon
VoidSubclass.Description:
On Powered Melee Hit:
Replaces Melee Ability with Soul Siphon for 20 seconds.

On Soul Siphon Usage:
Tethers up to 4 enemies within 20 meters, dealing increasingly higher Melee Damage Ticks every 0.2 seconds and pulling enemies towards the user over 3.2 seconds.
The final pull (after 0.6 seconds from the first tick) is guaranteed to stagger enemies.

Grants +15 Void Overshield for 15+7.5 seconds and ?% Class Ability Energy per enemy per tick.
With Echo of Persistence equipped, the Overshield Duration cannot be refreshed to 22.5s unless it is ≤15 seconds.

StasisVerbs.Name: Stasis Shard
StasisVerbs.Description:
Stasis Subclass Intrinsic:
Shattering a Stasis Crystal or Frozen Enemy, or killing an enemy affected by a Stasis Debuff (Slow, Freeze) spawns a Stasis Shard. 
Small Stasis Shard = Rank-And-File
Large Stasis Shard = Elites, Minibosses, Bosses, and Guardians.

Stasis Elemental Pickup:
Stasis Shards grant Melee Ability Energy on pickup. 
Shards last for 20 seconds. Allies receive a copy of all Shards created by the user.
Small Stasis Shards grant 10% Melee Energy, and Large Stasis Shards grant 50% Melee Energy.

While Glacial, Grim or Tectonic Harvest is equipped:
Small Stasis Shards restore 10 HP and grant x1 Frost Armor.
Large Stasis Shards restore 20 HP and x3 Frost Armor.

StasisVerbs.Name: Stasis Crystal
StasisVerbs.Description:
Solid Pillars that can be spawned on surfaces, possessing a varying amounts of health depending on their size, lasting up to 15 seconds.

Crystals, upon being created, inflict freeze [x15 Slow Stacks for 1.5+0.5 seconds] to enemies within 2.6 metres. 

Stasis Crystals can be destroyed by depleting their health, dealing up to 175 [25] damage in a 8 metre radius.

Small Crystals: ? HP | Medium Crystal: ? HP | Large Crystal: ? HP
User deals double damage to their own Crystals.

StasisVerbs.Name: Frost Armor
StasisVerbs.Description:
Grants 7% [2%] Damage Resist per stack, up to 31.25% [10%] Damage Resist at x5 stacks
Frost Armor decays 1 stack at a time every 5 seconds.
Damage Resist per stack is decreased to ?% [?%] while in Super.

Whisper of Rime:
Increases the maximum stack amount to x7, increasing the maximum Damage Resist to 50% [16%]
Increases the Frost Armor stack duration to 6 seconds.

StasisVerbs.Name: Slow
StasisVerbs.Description:
Slowed Enemies receive multiple penalties related to movement or weapon performance.
Freeze occurs upon reaching x100 Slow.

Slowed Combatants have 50% Decreased Movement Speed and are less accurate.

Slowed Guardians have 50% Reduced Movement Speed, 50% Decreased Jump Height, are unable to use Movement Abilities, receive ?% increased Flinch, and have a penalty to their Weapon Stats.

Slowed Weapon Stat Penalties:
Stability, Handling, Reload Speed and Recoil Direction are decreased by 75%.
Stat Reduction takes place after Weapon Perks. Weapon Stats are considered uncapped before slow's reduction is applied.
Eg: 160 Reload Speed will be reduced be 40 Reload Speed. 80 Handling would be reduced to 20 Handling.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon receiving any amount of Slow Stacks.

StasisVerbs.Name: Freeze
StasisVerbs.Description:
Frozen Enemies are completely immobilized, rendering them unable to shoot, use abilities, or move.
Frozen Enemies receive 10% increased damage from Special and Power Weapons, 5% increased damage from Arc, Solar, and Void Abilities, and 5% [60%] decreased damage from Primary Weapons. 
Frozen Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants, as well as Guardians receive 120% increased Basic Melee and Glaive Melee Attack Damage.

Frozen Enemies shatter after receiving varying [200] damage.

Frozen Enemies are immobilized for 6 [1.35 to 4.75] seconds. 
Boss Combatants are unhindered by freeze and automatically shatter after 3 seconds.
Grounded Guardians can cast their Super Ability to instantly break out.

Brief Freeze:
Guardians frozen by other Guardians are frozen for 1.35 seconds

Prolonged Freeze:
Guardians that become frozen by Combatants, or by Stasis Super Abilities, are frozen for 4.75 seconds.
Frozen Guardians have their Class Ability replaced with Breakout, which allows breaking out of the long-lasting freeze, in exchange for ? Health.
Guardians that are frozen during a Roaming Super automatically break out after a second, while One-off Supers get deactivated if frozen during the cast animation.

StasisVerbs.Name: Shatter
StasisVerbs.Description:
Frozen Enemies can be shattered through damage or directly through specific Stasis Aspects, dealing up to 400 [?] damage to enemies within ? metres.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon receiving shatter damage.

StasisSubclass.Description:

Refills all weapons and grants +40 Handling for 5 seconds.

StasisSubclass.Description:

40% = Miniboss

StasisSubclass.Description:

Includes Fighting Lion, Revision Zero, Vex Mythoclast, and their respective alternate fire modes.

StasisSubclass.Description:

Dealing or receiving Physical Melee Damage applies x10? Slow for ?+? [?+?] seconds.

Dealing damage charges Blight at a rate of 2% Blight per damage instance, reaching 100% Blight after dealing damage 50 times.
Blight decays at a rate of 3.33% every 1.2 seconds after not firing for 1.3 seconds, fully decaying after 41.1 seconds.
Grants increased Reload Speed based on the amount of Blight Seekers prepared.
Blight charge persists through stow, and decays normally.

On Reload:
Triggers Panic Response, converting all stored Blight into Blighted Seekers, at a rate of 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight, up to a maximum of 6 Seekers.
Always rounds up to the nearest Seeker number. Eg: 1% Blight = 1 Seeker, 52% = 4 Seekers, 84% = 6 Seekers. 
Blight Seekers are fired at a rate of 450RPM Hipfire | 720RPM ADS, overwriting regular shots.
Panic Response lasts for 7 seconds, and persists through stow.

Taken Resolution
Dealing damage to 3 enemies within ? seconds of each grants 50% Blight.
Blighted Seekers deal 160 [6.85 Guardians | 81 Constructs] Damage over 3? meters on hit.
Blight Seekers pierce through enemies, seeking a maximum of 2 additional enemies within 10? meters of each.
Seekers can re-target enemies already hit by them.

Taken Ambition
Scoring 12 damage instances within ? seconds of each on a single enemy or construct grants 22% Blight. Due to rounding, dealing damage 24 times is enough to grant 6 Seekers.
Blighted Seekers explode on impact, dealing 41 [9?] Impact Damage and up to 499 [21?] Explosive Damage.

↑Selectable Retrofit:
Grants the option to slot-in High-Impact Reserves, Hatchling, One For All, or Target Lock trait equivalents.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Revision Zero
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Craftable Kinetic Pulse Rifle
Selectable Origin Traits, between Heavy Burst Frames and Aggressive Burst Frames. 

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a stack of Targeting Data, up to 4 stacks after 48 Precision Hits.

Hunter's Trace:
Hold [Reload] while at least one stack of Targeting Data is loaded to swap into Hunter's Trace. Ammo loaded is equal to the amount of Targeting Data stacks acquired.
Replaces the 18 Zoom Scope with a 50 Zoom Scope. Fires with perfect accuracy, and has a Red Sniper Rifle Glint.
Fires High-Damage Hunter's Trace Rounds that deal 557.2 [158] Damage with a 3x Precision Multiplier at 72RPM and inherit the Shield-Piercing effect.
Scoring a Hunter's Trace hit triggers a Kinetic Shockwave that deals 280 [20] Damage and exhausts.
Hunter's Trace persists through stow and can only be deactivated by fully emptying the magazine or dying.

↑Selectable Retrofit:
Grants the option to slot-in Feeding Frenzy, Fourth Time's The Charm, Outlaw, or Under Pressure trait equivalents. Fourth Time's The Charm allows firing up to 6 Sniper Shots.
ExoticWeapons.Comment:

ExoticWeapons.Name: Sturm
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Aggressive Hand Cannon

Kills refill Energy Weapon's Magazine.

Kills with Drang grant a stack of Overcharged Round, up to 99 stacks.
Overcharged Rounds deal 262% [78%] increased damage.
 Overcharged Rounds persist on stow, and are lost on death.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Range and +40 Handling.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Sturm
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Aggressive Hand Cannon

Kills refill Energy Weapons Magazine and +1 Increased Together Forever Magazine Capacity, up to a maximum of 100% Increased Magazine Capacity.

Kills with Together Forever Weapons load an Overcharged Round.
Scoring multiple kills within 3 seconds of each loads additional rounds, up to a maximum of 25 loaded rounds.
2 Rapid Kills = +2 Overcharged Rounds per kill | 3+ Rapid Kills and onwards = +3 Overcharged Rounds per kill.

Firing consumes an Overcharged Round to deal increased damage.
300% increased damage = Rank-and-File and Elites | 280% = Mini-bosses and Champions
260% increased damage = Bosses | 75% = Guardians
Overcharged Rounds persist through stow and are lost on death.

↑Helping Hands: Passively grants +20 Range and +40 Handling.
Overcharged Round Kills grants 2 stacks of Definitely-Not-Shot Swap, up to a maximum of 6 stacks.
 
Upon stowing Sturm or a Together Forever Weapon:
Consumes a stack of Helping Hands, granting 0.5x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier.

ExoticWeapons.Name: SUROS Regime
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Adaptive Auto Rifle
Selectable Trait between Dual Speed Receiver and Spinning Up. 
Hold [Reload] to swap shooting modes.

Kills have a 25% chance to begin Health Regeneration and restore 20HP.

Dual Speed Receiver turns the weapon into a High-Impact Auto Rifle Frame with +3 Zoom and +30 Range while ADS.
Scoring kills while Dual Speed Receiver ADS is active grants 1.?x Heavy Ammo Progress Multiplier.

Spinning Up grants 0.83x to 0.67x Fire Recovery Delay while holding down the trigger. 
RPM increases every 12 bullets while holding down the trigger. Releasing the trigger resets the buff.
Scoring kills while Spinning Up is active grants 1.?x Special Ammo Progress Multiplier.

As magazine progressively decreases below 50%, down to 0%:
5% to 10% increased damage.

↑SUROS Ascendance:
Passively grants +50 Recoil Direction.
Kills have a 50% chance to restore health.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Sweet Business
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Minigun High-Impact Auto Rifle

Rapidly shoots bullets that deal 37 [16.45] damage with a 1.54x Precision Multiplier.

On Special or Power Ammo Pickup: 
Refills magazine.

While holding down the trigger:
Spins up the weapon, gradually granting up to 0.4x Fire Recovery Delay and +? Range over 1.38 seconds.
Grants -15% Hipfire Accuracy Cone Size while fully spun up.

Fires an explosive round every 18 shots, dealing up to 51 [21] damage. 
Explosive Shot requirement is lowered to 8 while fully spun up.
Explosive does not suffer Damage Falloff. 

↑Serious Business:
Grants 25% Flinch Resistance while fully spun up.

ExoticWeapons.Name: The Navigator
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Strand Adaptive Trace Rifle

Upon scoring 8 hits within 1 second of each on an ally:
Ally restores 60HP, begins Health Regeneration, and is granted Woven Mail. Wielder is granted Woven Mail and generates 5 Ammo.
If Shields are healed, then Shields will recharge, otherwise only up to Critical Health.

Upon scoring 20 hits within 1 second of each:
Inflicts sever, and grants the wielder Woven Mail.

While Woven Mail is active:
Grants 25% [5%] increased damage and +40 Ammo Generation.

↑Gordian Knot. Hold [Reload] to swap into Grapple Tangle Firing Mode. 
Grapple Tangle Mode shoots a Grapple Tangle up to 23.5 meters away at the cost of 1 Ammo.
Shows a preview of the Grapple Tangle impact spot while Alternate Fire Mode is active.
Incurs a 30 second cooldown before Alt Fire can be activated upon creating a Grapple Tangle. Must land on the ground for the timer to begin. Stowing swaps back to Trace Rifle Mode.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Thorn
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Adaptive Hand Cannon 
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

Direct hits corrupt, dealing 26 [0.4] Kinetic Damage after a 0.3 seconds delay, every 0.5 seconds 4 times, dealing up to 112 [1.6] Kinetic Damage over 2 seconds.
Corruption can be stacked.

Kills create a floating Remnant that home in towards the user while within 10? metres.
Remnants refill 4 Ammo, overflowing up to 40 Ammo, and grant Soul Devourer for an initial duration of 7 seconds on pickup.
Soul Devourer increases Corruption Damage by 200% [1750?%]. 
Picking up additional Remnants extend the duration of Soul Devourer by +7 seconds, up to 11 seconds.
Soul Devourer persists through stow.

↑Refined Soul:
Passively grants +15 Range, +5 Stability, and +5 Airborne Effectiveness.
Scoring a kill or picking up a Remnant grant Refined Soul for 7 seconds.
Refined Soul grants additional +10? Range, +15? Handling, and +50 Mobility.
Picking up additional Remnants, or scoring additional kills extend the duration of Refined Soul by +7 seconds, up to 11 seconds.
Refined Soul remains active while stowed.
ExoticWeapons.Comment:
Mark of the Devourer
Soul Devourer
↑Refined Soul

ExoticWeapons.Name: Touch of Malice
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle
Hold [Reload] to trigger Blight Launcher once charged. Swap Speed is tied to Reload Speed.
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

Scoring Precision Hits grants a stack of Charged With Blight, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Charged With Blight grants up to +? Stability and +? Reload Speed at 10 stacks.
Blight Launcher Mode can be toggled once at 10 stacks. 

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress through Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of each:
 Rank-And-File = 50% | Elites/Minibosses/Bosses = 100% | Guardians = 66.7%.
Begins Health Regeneration and restores 105 HP.

While Magazine = 1:
Deals 154% [30%] increased damage, drains 7 HP per shot, and is automatically refilled. Health Drain is not lethal.
Blight Launcher's Damage benefits from the Final Round's Damage Increase. Health Drain is affected by Damage Resist.

Blight Launcher:
Shoots a slow moving Blight that deals 208 [113] Arc Damage on direct impact, and has a damaging field that deals 1 damage, blinds and corrupts enemies.
Corrupt deals 25 [0.375?] Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds for 3.5 [2] seconds a total of 7 [4] times.
Enemies hit by the Blight receive 50% increased damage taken from Weapons of Sorrow for 5 seconds.
Triggering the Blight Launcher begins Health Regeneration and restores 105 HP.

↑Touch of Mercy:
Grants the Precision Instrument trait.
ExoticWeapons.Comment:
Touch of Malice
Charged With Blight
↑Touch of Mercy
↑Precision Instrument

ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Adaptive Sidearm

Kills grants a stack of Gathering Light, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Gathering Light grants +15 Handling, +15 Reload Speed, and +2 Aim Assist per stack.
Gathering Light stacks persist through stow.

Holding [Reload] will trigger a special reload animation, consuming all stacks of Gathering Light to provide Ability Energy.
Grants 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy per Gathering Light stack

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +2 Magazine Size (15 -> 17), the Osmosis trait, and the Surplus trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Verglas Curve
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Stasis Lightweight Bow
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Kills grant a stack of Hail Barrage, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Hipfiring releases every stored Hail Barage Arrow in a volley, spread out evenly. 
Hail Barrage stacks persist through stow.

Hail Barrage Arrows create a Large Stasis Crystal on impact, and inflict x100 [x60 for 1+1 seconds] Slow on direct hit.

Deals 50% increased damage against Frozen Enemies and Stasis Crystals. Stacks multiplicatively with Whisper of Rending and Frozen Enemy Multipliers.

↑Shiver Quiver:
Grants 0.65x Draw Time Multiplier for 5 seconds upon inflicting freeze or slow.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Vigilance Wing
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic 5-Round Burst High-Impact Pulse Rifle

Shoots a burst of 5 bullets, each dealing 38 [16] damage with a 1.62x Precision Multiplier.

On Ally Death within 24 metres:
+20 Mobility, 33% Increased Slide Distance, and 6.25% Increased Sprint Speed for 6 seconds.
Begins Health Regeneration.

While Last Guardian Standing or Solo: 
+100 Health Stat, +X Handling, and +30? Reload Speed.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the Ensemble trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Wicked Implement
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Stasis Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle

Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 4.5 seconds of each grants Creeping Attrition for 4.5 seconds. 
Additional Precision Hits refresh the duration of Creeping Attrition.
Creeping Attrition is removed on stow.

While Creeping Attrition is active:
Precision Hits inflict x40 [x20] Slow for 4+4 [4+2] seconds. 

Scoring a Precision Kill or shattering a Stasis Crystal creates a Small Stasis Shard that returns to the wielder.
 Incurs a 2 second cooldown between spawning shards.

Collecting Stasis Shards or destroying Stasis Crystals refills Magazine.

↑Hadopelagic Tribute: 
Stasis Shards additionally grant +5 Ammo on pickup, overflowing up to 100% Increased Magazine Capacity, and the Headstone trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Wish-Ender
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Lightweight Combat Bow

[ADS] while fully-drawn grants Truesight, displaying enemy silhouettes through walls up to 64 metres away.
Truesight lasts until no longer ADS, or after 3 seconds of being active. Must fully redraw to reactivate the perk.

Arrows deal a total of 595 [159] damage split into 3 [2] different damage instances.
The initial arrow impact deals 125 [129] damage and is affected by Precision Hits.
The two [one] instances from Broadhead deal [235] [28.75] damage and are not affected by Precision Hits.
Draw Strength affects the damage of all damage instances.

25% Increased damage against Combatants stuck by Witherhoard's Blight. 
10% Increased damage against Taken Combatants.

↑Catalyst: Grants the One For All trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Wish-Keeper
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Craftable Strand Precision Bow

Precision Hits and Kills charge up Snareweaver Arrows. Snareweaver requires 6 charges to be activated.
Precision Hits = 1 | Rank-and-File = 1 | Elite+ = 2 | Guardian = 3
When fully charged, hipfire to shoot a Snareweaver Arrow.

Snareweaver Arrow:
Hitting an enemy directly releases a snare underneath them and applies suspend.
Creates a snare with 6 linked traps in a ⏏ shape on impact. Traps last 15 seconds and have 10 HP. 
Enemies that come into contact with the linked traps are dealt ? [5] damage and become suspended.
Suspending 2 enemies breaks a beam. A snare can suspend up to 6 enemies. 
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between repeated suspensions on a single enemy.

Deals 50% [20%] increased damage against Suspended enemies.
Bodyshot Hits against Suspended enemies deal an additional 50% increased damage. Displays as yellow numbers, but will not be counted as Precision Hits.

Upon suspending an enemy, or upon damaging a Suspended enemy with this weapon:
+100 Reload Speed and 0.7x Draw Time Multiplier for ? seconds.

↑Catalyst grants multiple craftable traits:
Enduring Snare Refit increases Snareweaver Trap duration by +10 seconds, to 25 seconds.
Multi-threaded Snare Refit increases the maximum amount of suspensions per trap to 3, totalling a maximum of 18 suspensions. 
Hatchling trait.
Vorpal Weapon trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Energy Slot Weapons
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Multi-Element Aggressive Sniper Rifle
[Reload] switches between the Arc, Solar, and Void Elements.
Chosen element persists through stow and death. Defaults to Void Element.

Grants 30% [10%] increased damage for 10 seconds upon inflicting or receiving an Elemental Effect that matches the currently selected Element.

Breaking a Matching Shield refills Magazine and grants 5 stacks of Ionic Return, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Guardians in their Super Ability count as having an Elemental Shield that matches the element of their Super.

Shooting consumes an Ionic Return stack, granting 15% increased damage and increasing the Precision Multiplier offset to 136/51 (or the Multiplier by +0.6667, or 19% Increased Precision Damage, on top of the previously mentioned 15%).
Breaking a Matching Shield while Ionic Return is active grants 5 Ionic Return stacks.
Ionic Return shots persist through stow and reloads.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Reload Speed and the Shield Disorient trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Borealis
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Void Rocket-Assisted Frame Sidearm

Fires two tracking bolts per shot, each dealing 263 [42.3] Void Damage with a 1.2x Precision Multiplier.

Each bolt restores 11 HP upon scoring a hit.

Kills progress a counter that grants Devour upon reaching 100%. Counter has no timer. Kills will not count while Devour is active.
Rank-And-File = 25% | Elite+ = 100% | Guardians = 25%

↑Splitvein Lineage: 
While Devour is active:
Hits inflict Weaken for 5 [?] seconds.
Grants +? Reload Speed and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Buried Bloodline
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Arc Precision Auto Rifle

Refills 10% Ammo every 0.34 seconds while sprinting.

Sprinting, sliding, and shooting builds up charge, granting up to +? Range and +? Reload Speed. 
Shooting grants 20% Charge per second after holding down the trigger for 0.267 seconds.
Sprinting grants, after a 0.25 second delay, 20% Charge per second. Must be actively moving to build up charge.
Sliding grants 10% Charge per slide.
Charge decays at a rate of -33% per second after not doing any of those actions for 1.1 seconds. Manual Reloads automatically empty the charge.

Kills while at ≥40% Charge cause the enemy to explode, dealing up to 174 [76] Arc Damage in a 12 meter radius.
Explosions triggered while at 100% Charge blind enemies for 10 seconds.

↑Static Buildup:
Passively generates 7% Charge per second and removes Passive Decay while Amplified. Passive Charge is additive to Active Charge. Manual Reloads still empty the charge.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Centrifuse
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Craftable Special Ammo Void Command Frame Auto Rifle
Projectiles despawn after ~100 meters.

Fanatical Lance is mechanically identical to Radiolaria Transponder, with massively increased damage.
Deals up to 721 [?] Void Damage with the explosion, and 140 [?] Arc Damage per tick with the Radiolaria Pool.
 Does not receive Origin Trait Enhancement from Artifact Perks.

While hipfiring:
Shoots a single projectile that splits into 5 slow-moving projectiles in a + pattern after 7.5 meters.
Initial projectile deals 100 [31] impact damage, and up to 899 [213] explosive damage over ? meters. Deals 10.5% increased damage compared to the split shot.
Each split projectile deals 18 [6] impact damage, and up to 180 [43] explosive damage over ? meters.
Consumes 5 Ammo per shot. Splits into fewer projectiles if Ammo <5. Does not deal self-damage.

While ADS:
Fires hitscan projectiles, each dealing 246 [40.25] damage with a 1.8x Precision Multiplier. 
Consumes 1 Ammo per shot.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the option to slot-in Destabilizing Rounds, Onslaught, and Subsistence trait equivalents.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Choir of One
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Arc Rapid-Fire Sniper Rifle

Upon scoring 3 Precision Hits within 6 seconds of each:
Grants x1 Bolt Charge.
Calls down a focused lightning strike that deals damage after 1.1 seconds, followed by a barrage of bolts after 0.5 seconds.
Focused Lightning Strikes deals up to 588 [300] damage over 5? meters.
Bolt Barrages is spread out in an X pattern and deals up to 353 [180] damage. Enemies can only be hurt once per barrage.
Precision Hit Counter is reset on stow.

Precision Kills instantly calls down a focused lightning strike and grant x5 Bolt Charge.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +25 Handling and the Triple Tap trait.

ExoticWeapons.Description:
Arc Adaptive Trace Rifle

Steadily grants up to 80% increased damage as Energy is accumulated.

Upon dealing damage:
Charges up 40% Energy/s for 1 second. 
Initial Charge has a 0.267 second delay before it starts incrementing. Not generating Energy for 1.05 seconds will remove all Energy over 0.2 seconds.

Upon picking up an Ionic Trace:
Slowly grants 50% Energy over 0.5 seconds.

While in the maximum damage state:
+100 Stability and +100 Reload Speed.
Hits spawn an Ionic Trace, up to once every 2 seconds.

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Stability, +20 Reload Speed, and the Supercharged Magazine trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Coldheart
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Void Adaptive Pulse Rifle

Scoring 27 hits leeches Void Debuffs in the order of Volatile -> Weaken -> Suppression.

Receiving Void Buffs refills Magazine. Reactivating Devour through kills also refills the magazine.

Releasing [Fire], or holding down the trigger for 0.4 seconds upon reaching 100% Charge shoots the weapon, fully emptying the Anticipation meter. 
Does not require reloading unless picking up an Ammo Brick while fully empty.

Anticipation:
Meter that charges over 160 seconds at base, which decreases the time needed to charge the weapon.
Dealing Kinetic Slot and Energy Slot Weapon Damage speeds up the rate at which Anticipation is filled, down to a minimum of 3 seconds to reach 100% Anticipation.
0% Anticipation = 4.85 seconds | 20% Anticipation = 4.25s | 40% Anticipation = 3.75s
60% Anticipation = 3.15 seconds | 80% Anticipation = 2.5s | 100% Anticipation = 2s.
Can't build up Anticipation while in the Fire Recovery Delay state.

Deals up to 3,303 damage per shot, 207% more damage than the previous charge level. 

67%–99% Charge | Projectile deals 2,251 [455] Damage. Solar Explosion deals up to 2,216 [345] Damage over 10 meters

Deals up to 6,728 damage per shot, 50% more damage than the 3rd charge, and 104% more damage than the 2nd charge level.

Strand Projectile benefits from Strand Weapon Surges. Solar Explosion benefits from Solar Weapon Surges.
